title: Parallel keys and keyways, high form (Passfedern und Passfedernuten, hohe Form)
notes: Callout on a drawing: 'Passfeder DIN 6885 - A 10 x 8 x 40' = form A (round ends), width b 10, height h 8, length l 40.
Form A: both ends round (end-milled keyway, slot shape). Form B: both ends square (disc-milled or for form B keys).
Shaft keyway depth t1 is measured from the shaft surface at the keyway centre line. Hub keyway depth t2 is measured from the bore surface.
Drawings often dimension the keyway as 'd - t1' (e.g. '30' on a 35 shaft); read that as t1 = 5.
The keyway length l includes the round ends for form A.
